cells.content: 保定伯 梁銘 仁宗即位，十二月己巳封，祿千五百石，世襲。宣德二年九月乙未卒於交阯軍中。

translations.literal: Baron of Baoding Liang Ming: When Emperor Renzong took the throne, on the cyclical day jisi in the twelfth month he was enfeoffed, with a stipend of 1,500 piculs of grain, hereditary. On the cyclical day yiwei in the ninth month of the second year of Xuande he died in the army in Jiaozhi.

cells.content: 珤 宣德十年二月辛未襲。景泰三年十二月丁未進封侯。五年二月賜誥券，予世襲伯爵。天順元年十月鎮陝西，還領左府。成化三年十二月卒。追封蠡國公，諡襄靖。

translations.literal: Bao: On xinwei in the second month of Xuande 10 he succeeded. On dingwei in the twelfth month of Jingtai 3 he was advanced to marquis. In the second month of year 5 he was granted patent and certificate, with hereditary earl. In the tenth month of Tianshun 1 he garrisoned Shaanxi, then headed the Left Bureau. He died in the twelfth month of Chenghua 3. Posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Li, posthumous title Xiangjing.

He died in the twelfth month of Chenghua 3 and was posthumously made Duke of Li with the posthumous title Xiangjing.

cells.content: 永福 正德八年八月壬戌襲。十年閏四月乙丑領南京後府。嘉靖元年改右府。九年五月有罪革任，卒。

translations.literal: Yongfu: On renxu in the eighth month of Zhengde 8 he succeeded. On yichou in the intercalary fourth month of year 10 he headed the Rear Bureau at Nanjing. In Jiajing 1 he was transferred to the Right Bureau. In the fifth month of year 9 he was dismissed for a crime and died.

He was stripped of office for misconduct in the fifth month of year 9 and died.

cells.content: 繼藩 嘉靖十四年七月辛未襲。十五年十二月管紅盔將軍。明年十月坐五軍營右哨。二十九年九月戊午領南京前府。隆慶二年十二月提督操江。五年五月癸亥領左府。萬曆二年十一月壬申提督南京操江，兼管巡江。

translations.literal: Jifan: On xinwei in the seventh month of Jiajing 14 he succeeded. In the twelfth month of year 15 he commanded the Red-Helmet Guard. In the tenth month of the following year he was assigned to the Right Wing of the Five Armies Camp. On wuwu in the ninth month of year 29 he headed the Front Bureau at Nanjing. In the twelfth month of Longqing 2 he supervised naval drill on the Yangzi. On guihai in the fifth month of year 5 he headed the Left Bureau. On renshen in the eleventh month of Wanli 2 he supervised naval drill at Nanjing and also oversaw river patrol.

translations.literal: Originally named Maidonkey. On renchen in the seventh month of Hongxi 1 he was enfeoffed as baron, with a stipend of 1,100 piculs, hereditary. In the second month of Xuande 4 he was advanced to marquis, with 400 piculs added to his stipend. He died in the twelfth month of year 8. Posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Liang, posthumous title Zhuangyong.

At the end of Tianshun he garrisoned Jizhou and was transferred to garrison Ningxia. In Chenghua 13 he was stripped of his title for a crime.

translations.literal: On renshen in the fifth month of Zhengtong 7 he was enfeoffed as civil minister of Fengtian, Assistant Guardian, Sincere in Purpose, Upright in Power, and Steadfast in Culture, with a stipend of 1,200 piculs; 300 piculs were soon added. translations.literal: On jichou in the first month of Tianshun 1 he was enfeoffed as Baron of Huaining. In the seventh month of year 5 he was advanced to marquis, hereditary. Died on dinghai in the first month of Chenghua 7. Posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Lai, posthumous title Wuyi.

translations.literal: On gengwu in the twelfth month of Hongzhi 15 he succeeded. In the intercalary fourth month of year 17 he was assigned to the Shenwei Camp. In the twelfth month of Zhengde 3 he commanded the Divine Engine Camp. In the seventh month of year 4 he headed the Front Bureau. In the tenth month he also supervised the Regiment Camp. Died in the sixth month of year 12.

translations.literal: He inherited the title in Jiajing 1. In the tenth month of year 3 he commanded drill in the Xianwu Camp. In the third month of year 7 he was assigned to command drill in the Fenwu Camp. In the ninth month of year 16 he garrisoned Ningxia. In the second month of year 18 he carried the seal of Left Vice General on imperial escort. In the first month of year 23 he garrisoned Gansu. In the twelfth month of year 26 he was arrested and imprisoned for a crime. Released from prison in the third month of year 27. Died on renxu in the eighth month of year 31. Posthumously executed in effigy; the title was abolished.
